visenamenska-mikrofiber-krpa-onyx-evolut.name: Multi-Purpose Microfiber Towel | ONYX Evolution Multi Wipe 1 pc
visenamenska-mikrofiber-krpa-onyx-evolut.shortDescription: The ONYX Evolution multi-purpose microfiber towel (Multi Wipe) is a universal, general-purpose towel for cleaning interiors, door jambs and wheels.
visenamenska-mikrofiber-krpa-onyx-evolut.description:
ONYX Evolution Multi-Purpose Microfiber Towel

The ONYX Evolution multi-purpose microfiber towel, known as the Multi Wipe, is a general-purpose towel made to cover the widest range of everyday car care tasks. It is designed for cleaning interiors, wiping door jambs, detailing wheels and generally removing dirt and moisture from a variety of surfaces. The dense microfiber traps dust, grease and product residue without smearing, while the soft structure stays safe even on delicate parts. Its versatility makes it the ideal go-to towel to always keep at hand, since one towel replaces several dedicated ones.

Key benefits

The towel is surface-safe, as its soft fibers glide without scratching (scratch free), so you can use it on hard plastics, glass and painted parts. High absorbency lets it quickly pick up liquids and products, speeding up the job and reducing the number of towels you go through. The fiber structure leaves no water marks or spots, which matters on glass and glossy surfaces. It is also truly multi-purpose, equally good for interiors, door jambs and wheels, simplifying the whole process and reducing the need for lots of different towels.

How to use the multi-purpose microfiber towel

For interiors, use the multi-purpose microfiber towel dry for dusting, or lightly dampened with a plastic and fabric cleaner. For door jambs and hidden edges, use the towel to pick up dirt and moisture after washing, while the surfaces are still accessible. For wheels, use it for final detailing and wiping, kept separate from your paint towels, since wheels collect the harshest grime. Fold the towel into several sides so you always work with a clean section, and for tougher areas use it with a suitable cleaner for better results.

Care and washing

To keep the towel soft and absorbent, machine wash it at a low temperature and air dry. Do not use bleach or fabric softener, as softener clogs the fibers and permanently reduces absorbency. Wash wheel and interior towels separately from paint towels, ideally together with other microfiber products so they do not pick up lint. With proper care, the towel withstands a large number of wash cycles without losing quality.

Who the multi-purpose microfiber towel is for

It is intended both for professionals in detailing studios and for anyone who maintains their own vehicle and wants one reliable towel for many jobs. It is an excellent choice for regular cleaning of interiors, door jambs and wheels, as well as for quick touch-ups during a wash.

vafel-krpa-za-staklo-onyx-evolution-waff.name: Waffle Glass Towel | ONYX Evolution Waffle Wipe 1 pc
vafel-krpa-za-staklo-onyx-evolution-waff.shortDescription: The ONYX Evolution Waffle Wipe glass towel, whose textured waffle weave absorbs more liquid and lifts marks for a crystal-clear, streak-free shine.
vafel-krpa-za-staklo-onyx-evolution-waff.description:
What is the ONYX Evolution waffle glass towel

The Waffle Wipe is a microfiber glass towel with a distinctive waffle texture, woven into small pockets that increase the contact area and absorption capacity. This structure traps and holds liquid and residue, so the glass stays crystal clear and smear-free, with sharp visibility. It is designed for the windshield, side windows, mirrors and all glass surfaces on the vehicle, and works equally well on mirrors and windows around the home. Thanks to its greater absorption capacity, it is also well suited to quickly picking up moisture and final buffing of the surface.

Key benefits of the ONYX Evolution waffle glass towel

The waffle texture brings two key benefits, greater absorption and a clean, streak-free result, because the pockets hold liquid instead of smearing it across the glass. The towel efficiently removes greasy film, dust and product residue, while the fine fibers stay safe and do not scratch (scratch free). High absorbency speeds up the job and leaves no water marks, which is crucial for clear visibility while driving. It is also multi-purpose, so one towel handles both your car's glass and glass surfaces at home, replacing several separate towels.

How to use

For best results, work on cool glass, out of direct sunlight. Spray glass cleaner onto the surface or lightly dampen the towel with water, then wipe in even, overlapping strokes. Ideally, use the towel in two steps, first with the damp side for cleaning and then with a dry section for the final buff to a shine. Fold the towel into several sides so you always work with a clean section and avoid smearing. For stubborn marks, repeat the process rather than pressing harder.

Care and washing

To keep the waffle glass towel's waffle structure and absorbency, machine wash it at a low temperature and air dry. Do not use bleach or fabric softener, as softener clogs the fibers and leaves a film that causes streaks on glass. Wash the waffle towel separately from rougher towels and lint-shedding cotton, ideally together with other microfiber products. With proper care, it withstands a large number of wash cycles without losing quality.

Who the ONYX Evolution waffle glass towel is for

It is intended both for professionals in detailing studios and for anyone who maintains their own vehicle and wants perfectly clean, streak-free glass. It is an excellent choice for regular cleaning of the windshield and windows, as well as glass, mirrors and windows around the home, especially for those who value greater absorption capacity.

ulozak-za-poliranje.name: Polishing Pads
ulozak-za-poliranje.description: Foam, hex and wool pads for machine polishing, 130mm/125mm.

sundjer-za-poliranje-auta-onyx-evolution.name: Car Polishing Pad | ONYX Evolution 130mm (Yellow, Polishing)
sundjer-za-poliranje-auta-onyx-evolution.shortDescription: The yellow ONYX Evolution car polishing pad is designed for the polishing and gloss-enhancing stage after correction. It removes light marks and prepares the paint for maximum depth of color.
sundjer-za-poliranje-auta-onyx-evolution.description:
What is the ONYX Evolution car polishing pad

The yellow car polishing pad is a medium-soft pad that comes into play once heavy and medium correction are done and the goal is clean gloss and a uniform surface. Its foam is finer and softer than cutting pads, so combined with a polish it enhances depth of color and removes remaining light marks.

Its 130 mm size and 125 mm backing plate make it the standard choice for finishing passes.

Key benefits

The pad delivers a uniform, glossy result without introducing new marks, since its structure cuts minimally and refines maximally. The softer foam conforms nicely to curved panels and edges.

Even polish uptake prevents smears and uneven gloss, the hook-and-loop backing keeps the pad stable, and quality material extends its service life.

How to use

Use the polishing pad with a medium to fine polish. Apply a small amount of polish, spread it at low speed and polish at moderate speed with light pressure, in overlapping passes.

For the best gloss, work with a clean pad and refresh it as needed during work. After use, wash it and let it air dry.

Who it is for

It is intended for anyone who wants visible gloss and depth of color, from professionals in the studio to enthusiasts finishing their own vehicle.

It is excellent for polishing after correction, refreshing paint and preparing the surface before applying protection.

sundjer-za-poliranje-130mm-onyx-evolutio.name: Polishing Pad 130mm ONYX Evolution Medium Cut (Dark Blue)
sundjer-za-poliranje-130mm-onyx-evolutio.shortDescription: The dark blue ONYX Evolution polishing pad is the most versatile pad in the range. It removes moderate scratches and holograms.
sundjer-za-poliranje-130mm-onyx-evolutio.description:
What is the ONYX Evolution polishing pad

The dark blue polishing pad is the medium-firmness option in the ONYX Evolution system and is most often the first choice for everyday paint correction. Its foam balances cutting power and refinement, so a single pad can fix a large share of common defects without stepping up to the more aggressive green pad.

Its 130 mm size and 125 mm backing plate make it practical for work on most panels.

Key benefits

The pad provides enough cut to remove moderate scratches, pad marks and holograms, while leaving a cleaner surface than coarse pads, which shortens finishing time.

The foam density ensures a stable footprint on the paint and even pressure, the hook-and-loop backing keeps the pad centered throughout, and durable material extends its service life over a large number of work cycles.

How to use

Use the polishing pad with a medium cut or all-in-one polish. Spread the polish at low speed, then polish at moderate speed section by section with light to moderate pressure.

For heavier defects, add more passes rather than more pressure. Clean the pad regularly during work, and after use wash it and let it air dry.

Who it is for

It is ideal for detailers who need one reliable pad for most jobs, as well as for enthusiasts who want a visible improvement in their paint without a kit of multiple firmness levels.

It works excellently for maintaining vehicles in good condition, removing wash marks and preparing the surface before protection.

sundjer-za-fino-poliranje-130mm-onyx-evo.name: Fine Polishing Pad 130mm ONYX Evolution (Light Blue, Polishing)
sundjer-za-fino-poliranje-130mm-onyx-evo.shortDescription: A soft pad designed for final gloss, hologram removal and work on delicate, soft paints. 130 mm diameter, 125 mm backing plate.
sundjer-za-fino-poliranje-130mm-onyx-evo.description:
ONYX Evolution fine polishing pad

The light blue fine polishing pad is softer than the yellow pad and is designed for the final polishing steps, when flawless clarity of gloss is the goal. Its finer, softer foam structure is ideal for removing holograms and micro-marring without introducing new marks.

A 130 mm diameter and 125 mm backing plate make it a reliable choice for finishing on all types of panels.

Key benefits

The soft foam enables an exceptionally smooth, deep gloss, especially on dark and delicate paints where every mark is easy to see. The pad evenly follows curved surfaces and edges.

Minimal cut with maximum refinement gives a clean result, while the hook-and-loop backing and quality material ensure stable operation and a long service life.

How to use

Use it with a fine polish or a hologram-removing polish. Apply a small amount of polish, spread it at low speed and polish with light pressure at moderate speed, in overlapping passes.

Work with a clean pad and avoid using too much polish. After use, wash the pad and let it air dry.

Who the fine polishing pad is for

It is intended for detailers and enthusiasts who want a flawless finish on dark and soft paints, as well as anyone removing holograms after correction.

It is also excellent for one-step polishing with a suitable polish, when the goal is gloss with minimal cut.

sundjer-za-finis-poliranje-130mm-onyx-ev.name: Finishing Polishing Pad 130mm ONYX Evolution Medium Cut (Black, Finishing)
sundjer-za-finis-poliranje-130mm-onyx-ev.shortDescription: The black ONYX Evolution finishing pad is the softest pad in the range, designed for final gloss and even application of glazes, waxes and sealants.
sundjer-za-finis-poliranje-130mm-onyx-ev.description:
Finishing Polishing Pad

The black finishing pad is the softest pad in the ONYX Evolution system and is used in the final step, when there is no more cutting, only enhancing gloss and applying protective products. Its very soft foam follows the surface perfectly and spreads product evenly.

Its 130 mm size and 125 mm backing plate make it the standard choice for the finishing stage on the entire vehicle.

Key benefits

The exceptionally soft foam delivers a clean, deep gloss with no risk of new marks, even on the most delicate dark paints. The pad easily conforms to rounded panels.

Even application of glaze, wax or sealant saves product and gives a uniform layer, while the hook-and-loop backing and quality material ensure stable operation and a long service life.

How to use

Use it to apply glaze, liquid wax or sealant, or with a very fine polish for final gloss. Apply a small amount of product and spread it at low speed with very light pressure.

Do not overload the pad with product. After use, wash it and let it air dry so it stays soft and clean.

Who the finishing polishing pad is for

It is intended for anyone who wants a perfect final gloss and professional application of protection, from studios to demanding enthusiasts.

It is ideal as the last step after polishing, before handing over the vehicle or before a photo shoot.

sunder-za-nanosenje-premaza-aplikator.description: Applicators for tire dressings, coatings and tire protection.

peskir-za-auto.description: Microfiber towels for drying bodywork and glass.

onyx-peskir-za-susenje-auta-onyx-evoluti.name: Onyx Car Drying Towel | Onyx Evolution Rapid Dryer
onyx-peskir-za-susenje-auta-onyx-evoluti.shortDescription: The Onyx Evolution Rapid Dryer car drying towel has two dedicated sides: the twisted-loop side absorbs water from the bodywork, while the other side wipes glass without streaks or smears. It absorbs over 1.5 liters of water.
onyx-peskir-za-susenje-auta-onyx-evoluti.description:
The Onyx Evolution Rapid Dryer car drying towel is made for those who want to finish the whole job, bodywork and glass, with a single product. The absorbent side with twisted microfiber loops soaks up over 1.5 liters of water, while the other side is smooth and tightly woven, designed specifically for glass.

Drying is the stage where paint damage most often happens and where the impression of the whole wash is most easily spoiled. A vehicle can be perfectly washed, but if streaks and smears remain on the glass, they are the first thing people notice.

Two sides, two jobs

The absorbent side removes moisture from the paint quickly and without smearing. Once the bodywork is done, simply flip the towel. The other side is dedicated to glass, and that is where the difference is most obvious. Glass is the most demanding part of drying. Leftover drops, water spots and wipe marks show most easily there, and ordinary towels often leave fine lint that is visible under any light, especially at night against oncoming headlights.

The smooth, tight weave wipes glass to a completely clear result.

Streak-free, lint-free drying

The Onyx car drying towel has microfiber fibers that draw water into the fiber structure itself instead of smearing it across the surface. The result is a dry, clean surface with no water spots and no wipe marks.

Onyx car drying towel: safe on paint and protective coatings

The soft fibers glide across the surface and carry water and fine contaminants away from the paint instead of dragging them across it. Used on a thoroughly washed and rinsed vehicle, the risk of micro-scratches and swirl marks is minimal.

The towel is safe over waxes, synthetic sealants and ceramic coatings and does not shorten the lifespan of the applied protection. On vehicles with a ceramic coating, water beads into large droplets that the towel only needs to pick up, with no rubbing and no pressure.

Where you can use it
– Windshield, side and rear windows – glass side, streak-free
– Mirrors, chrome and gloss black trim, where marks show most easily
– Bodywork – absorbent side, panel by panel
– Interior glass, together with a glass cleaner
– Motorcycles, helmets, bicycles and campers

Do not use the Onyx car drying towel you use for paint and glass on wheels and lower parts of the vehicle – brake dust and sand particles get trapped in the fibers and later cause marks.

How to use the Onyx Car Drying Towel
1. Wash the vehicle thoroughly and rinse it well with clean water.
2. Using the absorbent side, go over the roof, hood, trunk and side panels without pressing.
3. Flip the towel to the glass side.
4. Do the windshield, side and rear windows, mirrors and chrome trim.
5. Leave the dirtiest lower areas for last or use a separate towel.

Wipe the glass while it is still slightly damp, as that is when a streak-free result is easiest to achieve. Work in the shade and on a surface that is not hot from the sun, because on heated glass water evaporates faster than you can pick it up and leaves spots.

Care

Wash the Onyx car drying towel at up to 30 °C, using only detergent without fabric softener. Softener coats the microfiber fibers, permanently reduces absorbency and leaves a film on the glass side that causes streaks. No bleach and no high-temperature drying. Wash separately from cotton laundry. With this care, the towel keeps its properties through a large number of wash cycles.

If the Onyx car drying towel falls on the ground, do not use it again before washing – tiny grains of sand in the fibers are enough to cause scratches.

Store it completely dry, in a closed box or bag, away from dust and other tools.

onyx-evolution-sundjer-za-grubo-poliranj.name: ONYX Evolution Cutting Pad 130mm (Green, Heavy Cut)
onyx-evolution-sundjer-za-grubo-poliranj.shortDescription: The green ONYX Evolution cutting pad is the most aggressive pad in the range, designed to remove deep scratches, oxidation and pronounced signs of wear.
onyx-evolution-sundjer-za-grubo-poliranj.description:
What is the ONYX Evolution cutting pad

The green cutting pad from the ONYX Evolution range was developed for the first and most demanding stage of paint correction. Its denser, more abrasive foam is designed for situations where the paint is in poor condition, with deeper scratches, swirl marks from washing, oxidation and pronounced micro-damage.

A 130 mm diameter and compatibility with a 125 mm backing plate make it the standard size that covers most panels on a car.

Key benefits

Its cutting power allows fast removal of defects that softer pads cannot fix in a reasonable number of passes. The open-cell structure spreads polish evenly and prevents oversaturating the surface.

Controlled heat retention reduces the risk of overdoing it on sensitive edges, the hook-and-loop backing provides stable, centered operation without vibration, and the durable foam keeps its shape even after multiple wash and dry cycles.

How to use

Pair the cutting pad with an abrasive heavy cut compound. Apply three to four drops of compound, spread them over a small area at low speed, then polish at medium to higher speed with moderate pressure, working section by section of about 40 by 40 cm.

Keep the pad clean during work and regularly remove excess compound so the cut stays consistent. After use, wash the pad in lukewarm water and let it air dry.

Who it is for

It is intended for professional paint correction specialists, as well as experienced enthusiasts tackling more serious paint restoration.

It is ideal for older and neglected paint, vehicles after long use, and surface preparation before applying a ceramic coating or PPF film.

onyx-evo-hex-aplikator-za-gume.name: ONYX EVO Hex Tire Applicator
onyx-evo-hex-aplikator-za-gume.shortDescription: The ONYX EVO tire applicator is a hexagonal foam pad for precise application of tire dressing. Even coverage without splatter, washable and reusable.
onyx-evo-hex-aplikator-za-gume.description:
The ONYX EVO Hex applicator is a professional hexagonal foam pad for precise, even application of tire dressings and coatings.

Its ergonomic shape with a hex (hexagonal) texture provides perfect control and clean application without splatter or wasted product.

Why a hex tire applicator?

Conventional sponges soak up too much product and leave an uneven layer. The ONYX EVO Hex applicator has a special hexagonal structure that holds the optimal amount of dressing and releases it evenly onto the tire. The result is a professional, uniform shine with no blotches and no mess on the wheels.

Main benefits:
– Hexagonal (hex) texture for even application
– Ergonomic shape that fits the curve of the tire
– Does not soak up too much product — less waste
– Clean application without splatter on the wheels
– Soft foam leaves no marks
– Washable and reusable, can be used many times
– Ideal for tire dressings, coatings and nano tire protection

How to use the ONYX EVO Hex tire applicator?
1. The tire must be clean and dry
2. Apply a small amount of tire dressing to the hex side of the applicator
3. Work it evenly into the tire sidewall using circular motions
4. Allow to dry according to the dressing manufacturer's instructions
5. If needed, wipe off the excess with a microfiber towel

Tips for the best result:
– Work in sections — one tire at a time
– Do not apply too much product at once
– After use, wash the applicator with warm water and soap
– Store in a dry place

Who is it for?

Ideal for anyone who uses tire dressings and coatings, from enthusiasts to professional studios. Compatible with all popular tire dressings and coatings on the market.

Package: 1 piece

onyx-evo-clear-ppf-zastitna-folija.name: ONYX EVO Clear PPF Paint Protection Film
onyx-evo-clear-ppf-zastitna-folija.shortDescription: ONYX EVO Clear PPF paint protection film for vehicle paintwork. Provides invisible protection against stone chips, scratches and UV radiation. Self-healing technology — light scratches disappear on their own with heat. TPU material, 10-year warranty.
onyx-evo-clear-ppf-zastitna-folija.description:
ONYX EVO Clear PPF paint protection film is a transparent film for vehicle paintwork, designed for professional protection against stone chips, scratches and external damage. Made from premium TPU material (thermoplastic polyurethane), it provides an invisible and extremely durable barrier against the everyday damage that spoils your vehicle's original look.

What is PPF paint protection film and why is it a must?

PPF (Paint Protection Film) is a clear protective film applied directly to a car's paint to protect it from everyday damage. Unlike a ceramic coating, which protects against chemical exposure, ONYX EVO Clear PPF paint protection film provides a physical barrier against road stone chips, sand, insects, branches and light wash scratches. It is the highest level of protection for original paint that exists.

Self-healing (Self-Healing technology)

ONYX EVO Clear PPF paint protection film features advanced self-healing technology. Light scratches and marks on the film's surface disappear on their own with heat — whether from the sun, warm water or a heat gun. The film returns to perfect condition, and your car stays flawless for years.

Main benefits of ONYX EVO Clear PPF paint protection film:
– Premium TPU material for maximum durability
– Self-healing technology — light scratches disappear on their own
– Fully transparent — does not change the look of the original paint
– Protection against stone chips, sand, insects and scratches
– UV protection prevents paint fading
– Hydrophobic surface — water and dirt are easily removed
– Resistant to yellowing over the years
– 10-year warranty

Technical specifications:
– Material: TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane)
– Dimensions: 1.52m x 15m (width x length)
– Type: Clear (transparent, gloss finish)
– Technology: Self-healing
– Warranty: 10 years
– Brand: ONYX Evolution

Who is ONYX EVO Clear PPF paint protection film for?

Ideal for detailing studios, professional film installers and all vehicle owners who want the highest level of paint protection. A 15-meter roll is enough to protect the front end of a vehicle (hood, bumper, mirrors, headlights) or for partial protection of several vehicles in professional use.

Where is PPF paint protection film applied?

Most often on areas exposed to stone chips: the front bumper, hood, front fenders, mirrors, door sills and headlights. For complete protection, the entire vehicle can be wrapped (full body PPF). The film can be removed without damaging the original paint when the time comes.

How is ONYX EVO Clear different from other PPF paint protection films?

ONYX EVO Clear is the result of long development in the ONYX Evolution laboratories, focused on three key properties: durability, transparency and self-healing. The TPU formula resists yellowing and chemical damage, while the self-healing layer ensures the film stays flawless for years, even in everyday use.

Combining with a ceramic coating

For maximum protection, ONYX EVO Clear PPF paint protection film can be combined with a ceramic coating. PPF protects against physical damage, while the ceramic adds chemical protection and hydrophobic properties. This is the professional approach used on luxury and sports cars.

Frequently asked questions

How long does ONYX EVO Clear PPF paint protection film last? With proper care, the film lasts 10 years, which is also the manufacturer's official warranty period.

Does the film change the color of the paint? No, ONYX EVO Clear is a fully transparent film. It does not change the color or look of the original paint — it only protects it.

Can I apply the film myself? It is technically possible, but for the best result we recommend professional installation. Improper application can create bubbles and wrinkles.

Can the film be removed? Yes, PPF paint protection film can be removed without damaging the original paint, even after years of use.

Does it protect against key scratches? It protects against light scratches, which disappear thanks to self-healing technology. Deep, deliberate key scratches can penetrate the film layer, but the paint underneath will remain untouched.

Application recommendation

Although self-application is possible, for the best result we recommend professional installation. M Polish also offers professional PPF paint protection film installation with a quality guarantee.

ONYX Evolution is a brand dedicated to premium vehicle protection. Delivery across Serbia.

mikrofiber-sundjer-za-poliranje-onyx-evo.name: Microfiber Polishing Pad ONYX Evolution 130mm (Heavy Cut)
mikrofiber-sundjer-za-poliranje-onyx-evo.shortDescription: The ONYX Evolution microfiber polishing pad combines the strong cut of microfiber with a cleaner finish than wool.
mikrofiber-sundjer-za-poliranje-onyx-evo.description:
What is the ONYX Evolution microfiber polishing pad

The microfiber polishing pad uses dense microfiber over a stable foam base and is designed for heavy paint correction, especially on dual action machines. It combines cut close to that of wool with a cleaner, more uniform finish.

A 130 mm diameter makes it a reliable choice for work on most panels.

Key benefits

Microfiber delivers strong, fast cut with fewer holograms than traditional wool, shortening the path to the final gloss. The foam base ensures even pressure and control.

The pad spreads polish well, the hook-and-loop backing keeps it centered, and its construction withstands washing and repeated use without losing performance.

How to use

Use the microfiber polishing pad with a cutting or all-in-one polish, ideally on a DA machine. Spread the polish at low speed, then work at moderate speed with moderate pressure, section by section.

During work, occasionally clean the fibers with a brush so they do not become saturated. After use, wash the pad and let it air dry.

Who it is for

It is intended for detailers who want correction power with a clean finish, as well as DA machine users who need an efficient cutting pad.

It is excellent for one-step and two-step corrections, as well as surface preparation before protection.

mikrofiber-krpa-za-staklo-onyx-evolution.name: Microfiber Glass Towel | ONYX Evolution Glass Wipe 1 pc
mikrofiber-krpa-za-staklo-onyx-evolution.shortDescription: A tightly woven towel for cleaning glass to a crystal-clear, streak-free shine. Leaves no streaks or lint.
mikrofiber-krpa-za-staklo-onyx-evolution.description:
ONYX Evolution Microfiber Glass Towel

Known as the Glass Wipe, this is a specially woven microfiber towel designed to clean glass without streaks or smears. Unlike standard towels, it has a denser, flatter surface that buffs glass to a crystal-clear shine and leaves clear, haze-free visibility. It is ideal for the windshield, side windows, mirrors and every glass surface on the vehicle, and works just as well on mirrors and windows around the home. Thanks to its fine structure, it leaves no lint or smeared marks, which show up most on glass.

Key benefits

The main advantage of this towel is a streak-free result, meaning clean glass with no lines or smears, which is essential for safe visibility while driving. The dense fibers trap grease, dust and product residue while staying safe on the surface and scratch free. The towel is highly absorbent, so it picks up liquid quickly and speeds up the job without leaving water spots. It is also multi-purpose, so the same towel cleans both your car's glass and the glass surfaces at home, replacing several separate towels.

How to use the microfiber glass towel

For best results, work on cool glass, out of direct sunlight. Spray glass cleaner directly onto the surface or onto the towel, then wipe in even, overlapping strokes. Ideally use two towels, one slightly damp for cleaning and another dry for the final buff to a shine. Fold the towel into several sides so you are always working with a clean section and avoid smearing. For stubborn marks, repeat the process rather than pressing harder.

Care and washing

To keep the towel fine and able to buff glass, machine wash it at a low temperature and air dry. Do not use bleach or fabric softener, as softener clogs the fibers and leaves a film that causes streaks on glass. Wash the glass towel separately from rougher towels and lint-shedding cotton, ideally together with other microfiber products. With proper care, it withstands a large number of wash cycles without losing quality.

Who it is for

The microfiber glass towel is intended for professionals in detailing studios and anyone who maintains their own vehicle and wants perfectly clean, streak-free glass. It is an excellent choice for regular cleaning of the windshield and windows, as well as glass surfaces, mirrors and windows around the home.

mikrofiber-krpa-za-poliranje-onyx-evolut.name: Microfiber Polishing Towel | ONYX Evolution Polishing Wipe 1 pc
mikrofiber-krpa-za-poliranje-onyx-evolut.shortDescription: A soft, highly absorbent towel for removing wax and sealant, without scratching or water marks.
mikrofiber-krpa-za-poliranje-onyx-evolut.description:
ONYX Evolution Microfiber Polishing Towel

The ONYX Evolution microfiber polishing towel, also known as the Polishing Wipe, is a soft towel made of dense microfiber, developed for the final steps of paint care. Its main purpose is removing excess wax and sealant from the surface, but it is just as useful for quick touch-ups and removing marks after washing. The dense, soft fibers capture product residue without smearing, so the paint stays clean and uniform. Thanks to its versatility, one towel covers a wide range of everyday tasks in the studio and the home garage.

Key benefits

Above all, the towel is paint-safe, as the soft microfiber glides across the surface without introducing new marks or holograms (scratch free). High absorbency lets it quickly pick up liquid and product residue, speeding up the job and reducing the number of towels you go through. The fiber structure leaves no water marks or spots, making it ideal for dark paints where every mark is easy to see. It is also multi-purpose, equally good for wax removal, polishing and final wipe-downs, replacing several different towels and simplifying the process.

How to use the microfiber polishing towel

To remove wax or sealant, wait for the product to do its job according to the instructions, then use the towel in even strokes to remove the excess and buff the surface to a shine. Fold the towel into several sides so you always work with a clean section and avoid smearing. For touch-ups after washing, use the towel to pick up remaining drops and water marks while the surface is still slightly damp. Work without pressure, as soft microfiber works best when you let the fibers pick up the residue on their own.

Care and washing

To keep the towel soft and absorbent, machine wash it at a low temperature and air dry. Do not use bleach or fabric softener, as softener clogs the fibers and permanently reduces absorbency. Wash the towel separately from rough laundry and lint-shedding cotton, ideally together with other microfiber products. With proper care, it withstands a large number of wash cycles without losing performance.

Who the microfiber polishing towel is for

fish-scale-krpa-za-staklo-onyx-evolution.name: Fish Scale Glass Towel | ONYX Evolution Fish Scale Towel 1 pc
fish-scale-krpa-za-staklo-onyx-evolution.shortDescription: The ONYX Evolution microfiber glass towel (Glass Wipe) is a tightly woven towel for cleaning glass to a crystal-clear, streak-free shine.
fish-scale-krpa-za-staklo-onyx-evolution.description:
What is the ONYX Evolution microfiber glass towel

The ONYX Evolution microfiber glass towel, known as the Glass Wipe, is a specially woven microfiber towel designed to clean glass without streaks or smears. Unlike standard towels, it has a denser, flatter surface that buffs glass to a crystal-clear shine and leaves clear, haze-free visibility. It is ideal for the windshield, side windows, mirrors and every glass surface on the vehicle, and works just as well on mirrors and windows around the home. Thanks to its fine structure, it leaves no lint or smeared marks, which show up most on glass.

Key benefits

The main advantage of this towel is a streak-free result, meaning clean glass with no lines or smears, which is essential for safe visibility while driving. The dense fibers trap grease, dust and product residue while staying safe on the surface and scratch free. The towel is highly absorbent, so it picks up liquid quickly and speeds up the job without leaving water spots. It is also multi-purpose, so the same towel cleans both your car's glass and the glass surfaces at home, replacing several separate towels.

How to use the microfiber glass towel

For best results, work on cool glass, out of direct sunlight. Spray glass cleaner directly onto the surface or onto the towel, then wipe in even, overlapping strokes. Ideally use two towels, one slightly damp for cleaning and another dry for the final buff to a shine. Fold the towel into several sides so you are always working with a clean section and avoid smearing. For stubborn marks, repeat the process rather than pressing harder.

Care and washing

To keep the microfiber glass towel fine and able to buff glass, machine wash it at a low temperature and air dry. Do not use bleach or fabric softener, as softener clogs the fibers and leaves a film that causes streaks on glass. Wash the glass towel separately from rougher towels and lint-shedding cotton, ideally together with other microfiber products. With proper care, it withstands a large number of wash cycles without losing quality.

Who it is for

It is intended for professionals in detailing studios and anyone who maintains their own vehicle and wants perfectly clean, streak-free glass. It is an excellent choice for regular cleaning of the windshield and windows, as well as glass surfaces, mirrors and windows around the home.

dvostrani-peskir-za-susenje-auta-onyx-ev.name: Double-Sided Car Drying Towel | Onyx Evolution Ultra Dryer
dvostrani-peskir-za-susenje-auta-onyx-ev.shortDescription: The Onyx Evolution Ultra Dryer double-sided car drying towel absorbs over 1.5 L of water. Dries without streaks or lint, safe on paint.
dvostrani-peskir-za-susenje-auta-onyx-ev.description:
Double-sided car drying towel – Onyx Evolution Ultra Dryer

The Onyx Evolution Ultra Dryer double-sided car drying towel is made for those who want to finish the job quickly, thoroughly and without a single mark on the paint. Thanks to twisted microfiber loops on both sides, it absorbs over 1.5 liters of water – enough to dry an average car in one pass, without stopping to wring it out halfway through.

Streak-free, lint-free drying

The tightly knit microfiber draws water off the surface instead of smearing it. The result is a clean, glossy surface with no water spots, no wipe marks and no leftover lint on the paint and chrome trim.

Microfiber absorbs water into the fiber structure itself, not just between the fibers like cotton or a sponge. That is why the surface stays dry right after each pass, with no need to wipe the same spot two or three times.

Safe on paint and protective coatings

The soft twisted fibers glide across the surface and carry water droplets and fine contaminants away from the paint instead of dragging them across it. Used on a previously washed and rinsed vehicle, the risk of micro-scratches and swirl marks is kept to a minimum.

The towel is safe over waxes, synthetic sealants and ceramic coatings and does not shorten the lifespan of the applied protection.

How to use the double-sided car drying towel
1. Wash the vehicle thoroughly and rinse it well with clean water.
2. Unfold the towel and lay it on a horizontal surface – the roof, hood or trunk.
3. Pull it across the surface without pressing; its own weight is enough.
4. When one side has absorbed enough water, flip the towel and continue with the other side.
5. Work your way down – upper surfaces, then the sides, and finally the sills and lower areas.

Leave the dirtiest lower areas for last or use a separate towel, so dirt is not transferred to clean surfaces.

Care

Wash the double-sided car drying towel at up to 30 °C, using only detergent without fabric softener. Softener coats the microfiber fibers and permanently reduces absorbency. No bleach and no high-temperature drying. Wash separately from cotton laundry. With this care, the towel keeps its properties through a large number of wash cycles.

crna-vuna-za-grubo-poliranje-130mm-onyx-.name: Black Wool Cutting Pad 130mm ONYX Evolution Heavy Cut
crna-vuna-za-grubo-poliranje-130mm-onyx-.shortDescription: The ONYX Evolution black wool polishing pad is an aggressive wool pad for heavy correction and fast removal of deep defects, especially on hard paints.
crna-vuna-za-grubo-poliranje-130mm-onyx-.description:
What is the ONYX Evolution Black Wool Polishing Pad

The ONYX Evolution black wool polishing pad is a professional wool pad developed for the most demanding first stage of paint correction, when deep scratches, oxidation, sand marks and heavy swirl marks from improper washing need to be removed quickly and safely. Unlike foam pads, wool fibers cut more aggressively and can more easily handle hard and ceramic-treated paints on which foam progresses more slowly. That is exactly why, for decades, wool has remained the first choice of many professionals for serious paint restoration. A 130 mm diameter and compatibility with a 125 mm backing plate make it practical and versatile for work on most panels, from the hood and roof to doors and bumpers.

Key benefits

The biggest advantage of a wool pad is its balance of cutting power and controlled temperature. Wool removes defects extremely quickly while generating less heat than dense cutting foams, which reduces the risk of damage on thin edges, panel body lines and sensitive areas. The fibers spread polish evenly across the surface and release it consistently during work, so performance is predictable and uniform from the start to the end of each section. The hook-and-loop backing ensures stable, centered attachment without vibration or pad slippage at higher speeds, while quality construction allows washing and repeated use without losing shape or performance. With proper care, a single pad lasts through a large number of work cycles, making it a cost-effective tool for everyday professional use.

How to use

The black wool polishing pad is paired with a heavy cut polish or compound, on a rotary or a more powerful DA polisher. Apply a few drops of polish, spread it at low speed to cover the work area, then polish at medium to higher speed with moderate, even pressure, working section by section of about 40 by 40 cm. For heavier defects, add more passes rather than sharply increasing pressure, since wool cuts fast anyway. During work, regularly clean the wool with a brush or compressed air so the fibers do not mat down and become saturated with polish, which preserves cutting efficiency. After use, wash the pad in lukewarm water with a mild shampoo, rinse and let it air dry with the fibers facing up, so it keeps its loft and shape.

Who it is for

The black wool polishing pad is intended for professionals and experienced users doing serious paint correction, especially on hard paints where foam pads progress slowly. It is ideal for older, neglected and heavily damaged surfaces, as well as for preparing a car before moving to finer pads and before applying a ceramic coating or PPF film. Because of its cutting power, it is recommended for those who have mastered machine polishing technique and know how to follow the wool step with finer refinement.
